versions.changelog:
Version 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Enables bid managers to track multiple construction tenders with deadlines, document requirements, and completeness.
- Maintains a detailed tender register including project info, submission status, and assigned team.
- Proactively warns users about approaching tender deadlines by urgency level.
- Tracks document completion for every bid, calculating and reporting completeness percentage and listing missing documents.
- Provides standard and customizable document checklists for each tender submission.
- Supports bid/no-bid decision-making by prompting evaluation criteria.
- Offers clear, dashboard-style summaries of all active tenders and their statuses.
